results.name: Backrooms Blender Kit
results.description:
A Blender scene containing Backrooms components to create unlimited Backrooms designs/environments. Contains scalable walls, carpet and ceiling components. Textures were created in Blender and converted to jpgs

Walls (white brick & Backrooms wallpapered) Should be edited in EDIT mode with ‘Correct Face Attributes’ selected in the options menu to maintain the correct texture scale. (see video)

The floor (carpet, two types) should be scaled in edit mode to maintain the correct texture scale. (see video)

Kit includes: 
Scaleable walls (which can be scaled to create pillars/columns) 
Scaleable carpet (two types) 
Air conditioner vents. 
Ceiling lights (emission shaders - for Cycles renders) 
Ceiling tile (use array modifier to create whole ceilings) 
Ceiling tile with AC vent

Youtube video demo.
https://youtu.be/CFNtyszl-_U

and a Youtube video created using the kit to create a Backrooms VHS clip:

https://youtu.be/-p123qNeVD8

results.name: PCGH-3R 4 Way Cassette Fan Coil
results.description:
The Polar Air PCGH-3R 4 Way Cassette hydronic fan coil has a discreet design, perfect for spaces with restricted space or ceiling height, as it doesn't use floor or wall space. It boasts optimum 4-way airflow for powerful and efficient distribution of cooled or heated air, with one of the highest cooling capacities on the market (up to 15 kW).

The sleek design features a direct valve connection for easy installation and low maintenance. Whisper-quiet operation with an energy-efficient 0-10VDC EC motor, delivering up to 30% more efficiency on average than traditional AC motors. Suitable for business, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, and education applications, like stores, classrooms, clinics, offices, hotel bedrooms and classrooms.

Control options include the W- and I-Type (intelligent control with the exclusive Polar Air Auto-Dynamic Balancing System).

Certified by Eurovent Certita and AHRI, the PCGH-3R meets rigorous quality, safety, and reliability standards.

results.name: PFWSL Slim Universal/Console: Round Case+Pad
results.description:
The Polar Air PFWSL(A) Slim Console/Universal hydronic fan coil has a slim design (only 250 mm depth). It achieves higher energy savings when paired with low-temp heat generators like heat pumps and solar collectors. Cased (square/round corners) or uncased, optional supporting feet, optional integrated wallpad. 

This is the cased PFWSL with round corners, with integrated wallpad. Can be installed vertically or horizontally, as exposed unit, wall-mounted, or in ceilings. Different row configurations plus 2- and 4-pipe models. 

Whisper-quiet, thanks to tangential fans mounted on anti-vibration supports, for smoother airflow. Easy to install and maintain, suitable for residential, hospitality, commercial, and healthcare applications, such as homes, restaurants, offices, stores and clinics.

Control options include W- and I-Type (intelligent control with the exclusive Polar Air Auto-Dynamic Balancing System). 

Certified by Eurovent Certitia and AHRI, the PFWSLA meets rigorous quality standards.

results.name: PFWSLU Slim Universal/Console: No Casing
results.description:
The Polar Air PFWSLU Slim Console/Universal hydronic fan coil has a slim design (only 250 mm depth). It achieves higher energy savings when paired with low-temp heat generators like heat pumps and solar collectors. This model is the uncased version, designed for concealed ceiling installations. It can be installed vertically or horizontally. Different row configurations available plus 2-pipe and 4-pipe models. It has a 90º return air section, so there is no need to select between horizontal or vertical air return.

Whisper-quiet, thanks to tangential fans mounted on anti-vibration supports, for smoother airflow. Easy to install and maintain, suitable for residential, hospitality, commercial, and healthcare applications, such as homes, restaurants, offices, stores and clinics.

Control options include the W- and I-Type (intelligent control with the exclusive Polar Air Auto-Dynamic Balancing System).

Certified by Eurovent Certitia and AHRI, the PFWSLU meets rigorous quality standards.

results.name: PFWB Universal/Console: No Casing HORIZONTAL
results.description:
The Polar Air PFWB Console/Universal hydronic fan coil is available in both cased (PFWBC) and uncased (PFWB) models, with optional supporting feet. This is the UNCASED HORIZONTAL model, PFWB. It can be installed vertically or horizontally, and either wall-mounted or installed on or within the ceiling. Different row configurations available, with 2-pipe and 4-pipe models for cooling and/or heating. 

Designed for high airflow and static pressure, operating with fewer revolutions for quieter performance. A ductless design simplifies installation, and it can be easily disassembled for maintenance. Suitable for residential, hospitality, commercial, business, education, and healthcare applications, such as homes, hotels, offices and conference rooms.

Control options include the W- and I-Type (intelligent control with the exclusive Polar Air Auto-Dynamic Balancing System).
 
Certified by Eurovent Certitia and AHRI, the PFWB(C) meets rigorous quality, safety, and reliability standards.

results.name: Living_room
results.description: This 3D living room project features a cozy, modern interior design. The room setup includes a central sofa facing a sleek TV mounted on the wall. Warm lighting illuminates the space, complemented by stylish ceiling lights. A coffee table sits in front of the sofa, with a plant pot nearby to add a touch of greenery. On the wall, picture frames create an inviting, personal atmosphere. An air conditioner is mounted discreetly above to enhance comfort. A piano in the corner adds an elegant touch, completing the room's balance of functionality and sophistication.
